name: electrical-mep-engineer
description: Electrical MEP Engineer: tender take-off toolkit for electrical/ELV CAD drawings - device QTO (cad-qto), Schedule of Load from SLDs (schedule-of-load), cable routing and length estimate (cable-estimate), and 3D models/renders from 2D drawings (cad-3d-render). Built for progeCAD + Excel on Windows.
